import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt from matplotlib.patches import Circle, FancyArrowPatch
mpl.rcParams.update({ "text.usetex": False, "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 11, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "text.color": "#263238", "lines.linewidth": 1.6, "svg.fonttype": "none", })
BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" SLATE = "#657786" INK = "#263238"
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.6, 4.0), dpi=100)
fig.text( 0.245, 0.945, "Physical System:\nCircular Lattice of 4 Coupled Masses", ha="center", va="top", fontsize=12, fontweight="semibold", linespacing=1.45, ) fig.text( 0.745, 0.945, "Equation of Motion and\nCirculant Stiffness Matrix " + r"$K_4$", ha="center", va="top", fontsize=12, fontweight="semibold", linespacing=1.45, )
ax = fig.add_axes([0.045, 0.145, 0.40, 0.665]) ax.set_aspect("equal") ax.set_xlim(-1.68, 1.68) ax.set_ylim(-1.68, 1.68) ax.axis("off")
radius = 1.08 mass_radius = 0.175 angles = np.arange(4) * np.pi / 2
# Coiled springs follow the circular lattice, with their ends at the masses. trim = np.arcsin(mass_radius / radius) for j in range(4): start = angles[j] + trim stop = angles[j] + np.pi / 2 - trim t = np.linspace(0, 1, 550) theta = start + (stop - start) * t envelope = np.minimum(1, np.minimum(t, 1 - t) / 0.10) r = radius + 0.048 * envelope * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 8 * t) ax.plot(r * np.cos(theta), r * np.sin(theta), color=SLATE, linewidth=1.6, solid_capstyle="round")
for n, angle in enumerate(angles): position = radius * np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle)]) ax.add_patch(Circle(position, mass_radius, facecolor=BLUE, edgecolor="none", zorder=4)) ax.text(*position, rf"$m_{n}$", ha="center", va="center", color="white", fontsize=11, zorder=5)
# Positive displacement is tangential and counterclockwise at every site. for n, angle in enumerate(angles): radial = np.array([np.cos(angle), np.sin(angle)]) tangent = np.array([-np.sin(angle), np.cos(angle)]) center = 1.405 * radial start = center - 0.205 * tangent end = center + 0.205 * tangent ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch( start, end, arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=11, linewidth=1.65, color=TEAL, )) label_position = 1.60 * radial ax.text(*label_position, rf"$x_{n}$", ha="center", va="center", color=TEAL, fontsize=11)
ax.text(0, 0.16, r"$N=4$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=15, color=INK) ax.text(0, -0.17, r"$m_n=m$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=11, color=SLATE) ax.text(0.87, 0.89, r"$\kappa$", color=SLATE, fontsize=13, ha="center", va="center")
fig.text(0.245, 0.115, r"Periodic boundary: $x_{n+4}=x_n$", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10) fig.text(0.245, 0.055, "Schematic • positive displacement counterclockwise", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8.5, color=SLATE)
eq = fig.add_axes([0.515, 0.105, 0.455, 0.71]) eq.set_xlim(0, 1) eq.set_ylim(0, 1) eq.axis("off")
eq.text( 0.015, 0.91, r"$m\,\frac{d^2 x_n}{dt^2}=-\kappa\,(2x_n-x_{n-1}-x_{n+1})$", fontsize=13, ha="left", va="center", ) eq.text( 0.015, 0.715, r"$m\,\frac{d^2\mathbf{x}}{dt^2}=-K_4\,\mathbf{x}$", fontsize=14, ha="left", va="center", )
matrix = np.array([ [2, -1, 0, -1], [-1, 2, -1, 0], [0, -1, 2, -1], [-1, 0, -1, 2], ]) rows = np.array([0.515, 0.425, 0.335, 0.245]) cols = np.array([0.395, 0.535, 0.675, 0.815])
eq.text(0.015, rows.mean(), r"$K_4=\kappa$", fontsize=15, ha="left", va="center") for i in range(4): for j in range(4): eq.text(cols[j], rows[i], f"${matrix[i, j]}$", fontsize=14, ha="center", va="center")
# Matrix brackets are drawn directly rather than using external TeX. left, right = 0.315, 0.895 bottom, top = 0.19, 0.57 hook = 0.025 eq.plot([left + hook, left, left, left + hook], [top, top, bottom, bottom], color=INK, linewidth=1.25) eq.plot([right - hook, right, right, right - hook], [top, top, bottom, bottom], color=INK, linewidth=1.25)
eq.text( 0.015, 0.075, r"$K_4=\kappa\,(2I_4-S_4-S_4^{T})$", fontsize=12.5, ha="left", va="center", ) fig.text( 0.522, 0.055, r"A polynomial in the cyclic shift matrix $S_4$.", fontsize=9.5, color=SLATE, ha="left", va="center", )
